Richard Sikang Bian is the Head of Product and Operations for Ant Ling, the foundational LLM at Ant inclusionAI. Leading the "Model as a Product" team, he drives GTM strategy, ecosystem development, and data sourcing while building innovative proofs-of-concept. A former software engineer at Microsoft and Square/Block, Richard previously served as Head of Open Source at Ant, successfully scaling the initiative into a dedicated cross-functional team through internal incubation. With extensive international experience spanning Singapore, Canada, the US, and China, he specializes in steering zero-to-one strategic initiatives and fostering cross-cultural collaboration to build world-class, user-centric products.

Richard is also an AAIF Ambassador and the former Outreach Chair of LFAI & Data Foundation.
speaker_title: Head of Product and Operations, Ant Ling LLM by InclusionAI

Thierry Carrez is the General Manager of the OpenInfra Foundation. A systems engineer by trade, he was involved in the inception of the OpenStack project, and still contributes to its governance and release management.

With a personal interest in the intersection of sociology and technology, Thierry spoke about open innovation and open source at various conferences around the world, including OSCON, LinuxCon, and FOSDEM. He currently serves as Secretary and Director for the Open Source Initiative. He was recognized as a Python Software Foundation fellow in 2012, and previously worked as the Technical lead for Ubuntu Server at Canonical, an operational manager for the Gentoo Linux Security Team, and an IT manager in various companies.
Zhou Qi is Head of Cloud-Native Application Platform and Vice Chair of the Open Source Committee, Alibaba Cloud Intelligence Group.
speaker_title: Head of Cloud-Native Application Platform & Vice Chair, Open Source Committee
